```powershell
Write-Output '=== STRUCT REDIRECT AND DIALOGUE MERGE 408 - THE ROW STRUCT PACKAGE REDIRECTED IN THE SCRATCH TABLE BYTES, THEN THE MERGE RUNS (Job 407 stands as the refusal record: the archive-verified OMNI dialogue table stands placed inside the merged base as Content\Data\DT_Dialogue_OMNI.uasset, and its load refused in the editor own words - Missing RowStruct while emptying the table, and VerifyImport: Failed to find script package for import object Package /Script/OMNI. The table row struct import names the OMNI module package /Script/OMNI; the merged base module is VEIL and carries its own PHIDialogueRow, the base table loading with 19 rows V01-V19, and the merge target census stands at 37 rows, V01-V19 plus O01-O18. OMNI and VEIL are both four letters, so the package path redirects at equal byte length and the file neither grows nor shrinks. THIS JOB, merged base at D:\VEIL-OMNI: one, census the scratch file bytes - print its size and SHA-256 and every occurrence offset of /Script/OMNI, /Script/VEIL, OMNI and VEIL in ASCII and in UTF-16LE, with 24 bytes of context printed around each /Script/ occurrence. Two, patch only the occurrences forming the package path /Script/OMNI to /Script/VEIL, keep a pre-patch backup of the scratch at Saved\dt408_backup.uasset, and verify in the same step - file size identical before and after, byte diff count equal to the four changed letter bytes per patched occurrence, span four bytes per ASCII occurrence and eight per UTF-16LE occurrence; if zero /Script/OMNI occurrences stand, print PATCH TARGET ABSENT and stop without writing. Three, load /Game/Data/DT_Dialogue_OMNI in a pythonscript commandlet on the merged base and print its row count and row names; if it loads None, print the commandlet log lines carrying the new refusal and stop with the base table untouched. Four, merge as job 407 shaped it - export both tables through export_to_json_string, base rows first and OMNI rows appended with any name collision printed, fill_from_json_string into the base table, save the base table asset. Five, verify from a fresh commandlet load: print the base table row count and every row name in order, the verdict MERGE COMPLETE rows=37 when V01-V19 and O01-O18 all stand, otherwise MERGE INCOMPLETE with the actual count and the missing names. Six, remove the scratch copy only after the verdict prints, printing SCRATCH REMOVED; the archive copy and the dt408 backup remain the sources of record.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 10) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'PHI DT408 NAMED HOLD: EDITOR STILL STANDING AFTER THE 100 SECOND IN-JOB WAIT - no commandlet launched into the contention'; Write-Output 'JOB 408 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output 'PHI DT408 EDITOR STATE AT PROCEED: no editor standing - proceeding on the clear road'
$cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
$base = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI'
$uproj = "$base\VEIL.uproject"
$scratch = "$base\Content\Data\DT_Dialogue_OMNI.uasset"
$backup = "$base\Saved\dt408_backup.uasset"
Write-Output '--- SECTION 1: BYTE CENSUS AND STRUCT REDIRECT PATCH ---'
if (-not (Test-Path $scratch)) { Write-Output 'PHI DT408 SCRATCH ABSENT - the 407 scratch copy does not stand in the base'; Write-Output 'JOB 408 STOPPED'; return }
$py = (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source
if (-not $py) { $py = (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source }
if (-not $py) { Write-Output 'PHI DT408 PYTHON NOT FOUND'; Write-Output 'JOB 408 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output "PHI DT408 PYTHON: $py"
$pyP = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyP = $pyP.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$base\Saved\phi_dt408_patch_out.txt'")
$pyP = $pyP.Replace('SCRATCHPATH', "'$scratch'")
$pyP = $pyP.Replace('BACKUPPATH', "'$backup'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_patch.py" -Value $pyP -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_patch_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $py "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_patch.py" *> "$base\Saved\dt408_patch.log"
$pout = $null
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_patch_out.txt") { $pout = Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_patch_out.txt"; $pout | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT408 PATCH OUTPUT FILE'; Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\dt408_patch.log" -Pattern 'Error|Traceback|Exception' | Select-Object -Last 6 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output; Write-Output 'JOB 408 STOPPED'; return }
$pjoined = $pout -join "`n"
if ($pjoined -match 'PATCH TARGET ABSENT') { Write-Output 'PHI DT408 STOPPED AT THE PATCH - no /Script/OMNI occurrence stands in the scratch bytes'; Write-Output 'JOB 408 STOPPED'; return }
if ($pjoined -notmatch 'PATCH DONE') { Write-Output 'PHI DT408 PATCH DID NOT COMPLETE - stop before the merge'; Write-Output 'JOB 408 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 2: LOAD AND MERGE COMMANDLET ---'
$pyM = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyM = $pyM.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$base\Saved\phi_dt408_merge_out.txt'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_merge.py" -Value $pyM -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_merge_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_dt408_merge.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\dt408_merge.log"
$mout = $null
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_merge_out.txt") { $mout = Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_merge_out.txt"; $mout | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT408 MERGE OUTPUT FILE'; Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\dt408_merge.log" -Pattern 'Error|Traceback|Exception' | Select-Object -Last 6 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output; Write-Output 'JOB 408 STOPPED'; return }
$mjoined = $mout -join "`n"
if (($mjoined -match 'OMNI LOAD NONE') -or ($mjoined -match 'BASE LOAD NONE')) {
  Write-Output 'MERGE HELD AT THE LOAD'
  Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\dt408_merge.log" -Pattern 'Error|Failed|DT_Dialogue_OMNI|RowStruct' | Select-Object -Last 10 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output
  Write-Output 'JOB 408 STOPPED'; return
}
if ($mjoined -notmatch 'MERGE WRITTEN') { Write-Output 'PHI DT408 MERGE DID NOT WRITE - stop before verify'; Write-Output 'JOB 408 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 3: VERIFY COMMANDLET - FRESH LOAD ---'
$pyV = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyV = $pyV.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$base\Saved\phi_dt408_verify_out.txt'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_verify.py" -Value $pyV -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_verify_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_dt408_verify.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\dt408_verify.log"
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_verify_out.txt") { Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt408_verify_out.txt" | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT408 VERIFY OUTPUT FILE'; Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\dt408_verify.log" -Pattern 'Error|Traceback|Exception' | Select-Object -Last 6 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 4: SCRATCH REMOVAL ---'
Remove-Item $scratch -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (Test-Path $scratch) { Write-Output 'PHI DT408 SCRATCH STILL STANDING AFTER REMOVAL ATTEMPT' } else { Write-Output 'SCRATCH REMOVED' }
Write-Output 'JOB 408 DONE'
```
